bio: Today's culinary landscape is characterised by a shift towards plant-based, zero-waste dishes underpinned by long-established techniques such as fermentation and pickling. At Restaurant Vannu, Gijs Kemmeren gives his creativity free rein, incorporating all those sustainable elements into a multi-course set menu. With seaweed, for example, he adds nuance to the earthiness of beetroot and fresh celery. He also whisks up an intensely flavoursome chanterelle sauce to tie together al dente vegetables and a millet polenta cake. His cuisine is sophisticated, playful and certainly intriguing. The accompanying natural wines and juices underscore the ethos of this establishment. A memorable dining experience is guaranteed....
